text:
nina.prod: Publishing a new "Region Lockdown" feature for Private/VPC installs today. This is focused on preventing control-plane and persistent-store replication across regions unless explicitly allowed in the SOW.

ops-oncall-bot: Feature gate created: PLAT-2600-region-lockdown (owner: eng-platform).

nina.prod: Key customer-facing points:
- Default behavior: region-lockdown = ON for new Private installs.
- Behavior when ON: etcd persistence and artifact stores are write-restricted to the chosen region; cross-region replication blocked by platform guardrail.
- Migration for existing installs: staged snapshot + import (customer-controlled storage) or opt-in cross-region export via signed S3 presigned flows.

suresh.se: Technical checklist to include in PS runbook:
1) Ensure etcd TLS mutual auth with customer CA.
2) Validate KMS key residency (no cross-region CMK references).
3) Confirm node time drift < 500ms (NTP).
4) Network: egress rules to block control-plane endpoints in other regions.
5) Test: attempt a cross-region write and expect 403 with explanatory error code.

alice.cs: For CS/AEs: prepare a 1-pager that explains options and expected downtime/costs during migration. Also include a sample customer script explaining how to temporarily opt-out for migrations with consent.

legal: Added SOW clause SOW-REG-1.2: "Customer may elect cross-region replication; Redwood will implement only on documented, signed authorization." Legal flagged customers must acknowledge potential impacts to compliance scope.

nina.prod: Platform note: eng-platform will ship the guardrail and a read-only dry-run mode that logs potential cross-region writes for 2 weeks before enforcement. Ticket PLAT-2600 has dry-run enabled by default for the first GA cohort.

ops-oncall-bot: Dry-run window scheduled: start 1812345800 end 1812349400 for installs in GA cohort.

suresh.se: Ops ask: add a recovery play for accidental region-lockdown toggles (rollback of guardrail + re-replication plan). Also add an automated check for encrypted swap and kernel version minimum.

nina.prod: added to doc. PS runbook will include recovery play and re-replication checklist.

alice.cs: I'll draft customer email + AE slide; will share by EOD tomorrow.

nina.prod: Please review the draft region-lockdown KB: https://internal.redwood/kb/region-lockdown (editor access). Will merge v1.0 at 1812345850 unless blockers. Note: this is product + legal + ops coordinated, customer-facing material so keep feedback concrete. :memo:

legal: Reviewing. Please ensure opt-in audit trail for any cross-region write requests.

ops-oncall-bot: Reminder: "Region Lockdown doc review" at 1812345840 for @suresh.se @legal.

nina.prod: Thanks everyone. Targeting GA rollout to invited customers next week under dry-run, with enforcement 2 weeks later after we gather logs and feedback.
